document: Approved building plan
verification_method: Check document presence, competent-authority approval, architect details, and consistency with supporting records
notes: Handbook states that the plan should be prepared by a registered architect or licensed surveyor and approved by the competent authority.

document: Affidavit 2
verification_method: Check presence, required stamp/e-stamp value, oath authentication, and digital-signature requirements applicable to the submission
notes: Confirm current requirements and applicable submission procedure before making a compliance decision.

document: Occupancy/completion certificate, building licence, or Form D as applicable
verification_method: Check presence, issuing authority, document dates, institution/property details, and authenticity where an official verification channel is available
notes: The handbook describes a conditional affidavit alternative in specified circumstances; do not apply a blanket missing-document rule.

document: Valid Fire Safety Certificate
verification_method: Check presence, issuing authority, validity dates, premises details, and official verification where available
notes: Check the rules applicable to the institution and application category.

document: Bank Manager financial-status certificate
verification_method: Check presence, issuing bank/branch, authorized signatory, date, and consistency with supporting financial records
notes: Presence and visual inspection do not establish that the certificate is genuine.

document: Trust/Society/Company registration document and governing documents
verification_method: Check entity name, registration details, members, objectives, and consistency across submitted documents
notes: The handbook specifies attestation/certification by the concerned competent authority.

document: Land/building ownership evidence and qualifying registered deed or lease
verification_method: Identify the ownership or lease arrangement; check the registered deed, parties, property identity, lease term, live lease condition, and any required supporting documents. Route private leases to the relevant land or building checklist.
notes: Annexure-1 section 1.1(xii): the Handbook lists specified registered settlement, sale, gift, government lease, or private lease documents. It specifies a minimum 30-year lease and a live-lease condition. Check the exact wording and applicability against the source PDF.

document: Copy of advertisement in at least one National Daily for recruitment of Principal/Director and faculty members
applies_to: New technical institution at Expert Visit Committee stage
verification_method: Check advertisement copy, evidence of publication in at least one National Daily, recruitment roles covered, and consistency with the institution's application. Flag uncertain publication evidence for review.
notes: Source wording confirmed in the Annexure-1 EVC document list. Verify the precise printed page and section numbering against the PDF before finalizing the source reference.

document: Affidavit 2 with applicable digital signature
applies_to: Existing institutions seeking EoA under the stated process
verification_method: Check presence, signer identity, authentication, stamp/e-stamp details, and digital-signature validity where verifiable
notes: Applicability depends on the specific application and current requirements.

document: Occupancy/completion certificate, building licence, or Form D
applies_to: Existing institutions seeking EoA under the stated process
verification_method: Check presence, issuing authority, premises details, and official verification where available
notes: The handbook includes a specific provision for certain older government buildings where original documents cannot be submitted.

document: Structural Stability Certificate
applies_to: Existing institutions where the handbook's stated building-age condition applies
verification_method: Check certificate presence, registered structural engineer details, date, building identity, and stated fitness
notes: The handbook specifies this condition for buildings more than thirty years from the issue of the Completion Certificate.

document: Valid Fire Safety Certificate
applies_to: Existing institutions seeking EoA under the stated process
verification_method: Check presence, issuing authority, validity dates, and premises details
notes: Confirm current requirements and any applicable exceptions.

document: Satellite map showing land location and latitude/longitude
applies_to: Existing institutions seeking EoA under the stated process
verification_method: Check map presence, coordinates, and consistency with the institution's stated location
notes: Coordinate consistency alone does not prove ownership or approval.

document: Previous-year audited statement of accounts
applies_to: Existing institutions seeking EoA under the stated process
verification_method: Check presence, reporting period, entity name, auditor/signature details, and consistency with other records
notes: Financial authenticity requires stronger checks than document appearance alone.

document: Applicant Organization resolution in Format 3
verification_method: Check the resolution is present, uses Format 3, identifies the applicant organization, and matches the proposed institution.
notes: Requirement stated in Annexure-1, section 1.1(iii).

document: Hard copy of the complete application uploaded to the AICTE Web-Portal
verification_method: Check that the complete application hard copy is present and corresponds to the submitted portal application.
notes: Requirement stated in Annexure-1, section 1.1(vii).

document: Recommended Board of Governors composition
verification_method: Check the recommended composition against Annexure-17 of the Handbook.
notes: Conditional requirement for Standalone PGDM Institutions.

document: Section 8 company MoA and Rules provision on non-profit objectives and use of surplus
applies_to: Applicant companies established under Section 8 of the Companies Act, 2013
verification_method: Check whether the MoA and Rules contain the provision described in the Handbook.
notes: Conditional requirement for companies established under Section 8 of the Companies Act, 2013.

document: Applicant Organization resolution for PPP/BOT proposal
verification_method: Check the resolution covers starting the technical institution and allocation of land, building, or funds to the proposed activities in Format 3.
notes: Conditional requirement for applications proposing PPP/BOT.

document: Additional evidence for private lease of land
applies_to: New technical institutions using privately leased land
verification_method: Check the registered lease between lessor and lessee, land conversion certificate, lessor title documents, encumbrance certificate, applicable lessor resolution, and registered sublease rights where relevant. Flag any land mortgage for review.
notes: Annexure-1 private lease of land list: lease registered under the Registration Act and valid for 30 years as of the Council's notification; land conversion certificate; lessor title evidence; encumbrance certificate; lessor Trust/Society/Company resolution where applicable; registered right to assign leasehold rights for a sublease; land mortgage is not permissible. Verify each condition against the applicable source and circumstances.

document: Additional evidence for private lease of building
applies_to: New technical institutions using privately leased buildings
verification_method: Check the approved complete building plan, occupancy/completion certificate, land title or leasehold evidence, registered lease deed, fire safety certificate, educational land-use certificate and maps, architect-certified floor plans, and working-capital proof.
notes: Annexure-1 private lease of building list. The Handbook specifies additional evidence, including approved plans; occupancy/completion documents; land title; registered lease; valid Fire Safety Certificate; educational land-use certificate with topo sketch/village map and road map; architect-certified plans showing rooms and carpet areas; and working-capital proof with bank evidence. Check the complete list across the relevant source pages.
